title: Studio Validations editor on a read-only package: ~20 disabled controls give no reason (no tooltip, no aria-describedby, no keyboard path)
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible product defect with a named landing and a reproduction. Reach: Studio on a read-only (code) package, reproduced 2/2 after a screenshot confirmed the render.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui Studio lane seat owning the Validations editor in the Data pillar. Apply the same read-only-reason treatment objectui#12303 gave the Field-properties inspector.

## What

On a read-only package, the Studio **Validations** editor renders about 20 disabled controls with no stated reason:
- no tooltip on hover;
- no `title` or `aria-describedby`;
- no keyboard path (Tab never focuses them).

The Publish button and the Enabled toggle on the same page do carry the reason: "Read-only package — switch to or create a writable package to edit."

## Reproduction (objectstack `main` `2034975a`, console pin `daeb77fc`)

1. As admin, open `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/data?surface=object%3Ashowcase_task`.
2. Click **Validations**. The rule "Task Status Flow" opens.
3. Hover the Severity combobox ("error (rejects the save)") for 1.5 s. No `[role=tooltip]` appears, and no `title` / `aria-describedby` / `tabindex` is set on it or its ancestors.
4. Tab through the page: no form control receives focus.
5. Expected: hover and keyboard reach the read-only reason, as Publish and Enabled do.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included → 11 hits, none matching (by the cloud runner). objectui#12303 names only the Field-properties inspector.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23953 · ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason · clause 0
